content: Sǝr Tagǝu Kǝra Biya Sara Wu Dǝl

Kǝ yi lari sǝr tagǝu a vǝr biya sara wu dǝl. Sǝr tagǝ kau aˈyi ja ǝnga tǝlǝmǝ kumou, ba ǝtsu ǝnga kǝr mǝɗǝfau. Aˈyi ja ǝnga dara tǝlkur kumou ar tǝlǝma nyiˈyar, ǝnga ar kalar kǝr, sǝr diɗa thlǝmǝr Hyal aˈyi ari.
Sǝr tagǝ kǝra yi lari kau, wu pa ufwa wula, ama aˈyi ja ǝnga hi ǝnggǝr nǝ cimjigǝl, ǝnga miya tsu ǝnggǝr miya lǝvari. Pabǝr vuwa ta nǝ nyi dǝnama nyi, ǝnga tsǝkafǝ nyi ba ǝnga dǝnama nǝ tǝlkur nyi.
Pathlǝu wu pama kǝra sǝr tagǝ ta ɗa ǝnggǝr ji uya mbǝlgǝ nǝ tau, ama mbǝlgǝ nǝ tǝ kau, ba shilǝgǝbiya dzau. Kǝ sǝkǝ ɗa sǝ dǝdǝgur anǝ duniya patǝ ba ndǝ dzǝgwa nu sǝr tagǝ ta.

Nju gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ pabǝr vuwa ta, arya ji nǝ nyi dǝnama anǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, ǝnga nji tsu ndǝ gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, ndu yiwa ndu na, “Wa ngǝ ǝnggǝr sǝr tagǝ ka? Wa nga sǝn pa ǝnga ja?”
Nji nǝ nyi miya anǝ sǝr tagǝu, aga ndǝr nǝ ɓwadzau ǝnga ndǝr nǝ diɗa Hyal, ǝnga nji piyari nyi ja ca dǝnama nyi nǝ hya foɗǝ kumunyi apǝ mǝthlǝu.
Kǝ ji pahǝna miya ja aga diɗa Hyal, ju diɗa thlǝmǝr Hyal ǝnga vir nggya Hyal ǝnga njira vǝr nggya a dǝmǝlmau.
Nji nǝ nyi dǝnama nǝ pa nji cici gǝ Hyal ǝnga ja sǝmku tǝlkur ar kǝra nda. Kǝ nji nǝ nyi dǝnama ar kǝra kalar culi, ǝnga nji, ǝnga miya ba ˈyiˈyi pampamǝu.
Patǝr njira wu duniya wu gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, kǝl njira thlǝmǝr nda aˈyi tsǝtsǝfau divira duniya a dzǝguya dzau wu lǝkakaɗǝ pi nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ kǝra nji thlana.
Ndǝra ǝnga himi ngga bǝgǝ ja nggari.

content: Culi sǝˈyar kau, wu yiwu nji cici gǝ Hyal nda nggya ǝnga sǝsu sau ba ǝnga mbǝrsa.
Sǝr Tagǝ Kǝra Biya Sara Wu ˈYiˈyi
Kǝ yi ɓǝra lari vanyi sǝr tagǝu kǝra biya sara wu ˈyiˈyi. Aˈyi ja ǝnga tǝlǝmǝ mǝthlǝu ǝnggǝr nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ, ama ju ndǝr ǝnggǝr nǝ pabǝr vuwa ta.

Ji mǝl thlǝr ǝnga patǝr dǝnama nǝ tǝlkur nǝ sǝr tagǝ tanggǝrma ta anǝ nyi. Ənga ji mǝliya duniya ǝnga njira a gwa gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ sǝr tagǝ nǝ tanggǝrma ta, kǝra mbǝlgǝ nǝ tǝ nyi ta a shilǝgǝbiyar dzau.
Ji mǝliya madiya mǝtsamǝ gangǝu, kǝlta ji mǝliya uˈu a shida sara a dǝmǝlmau wu liya nji patǝu.

Arya dǝnama kǝra nji nǝ nyi aga mǝl mǝtsamǝ nǝ sǝ dǝdǝgur kǝra ji mǝliya ar viya sǝr tagǝ nǝ tanggǝrma ta, ba ji nggutana njira wu duniya. Ji ciwa nda aga nda hǝriya sǝra a papa sǝr tagǝ ta nji uya nyi ǝnga mbǝlgǝ nǝ katsakǝr ama naja aˈyi tǝ mai ta aga nda gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli.
Nji nǝ nyi dǝnama nǝ lǝ sǝpi anǝ sǝra nji hǝriya kǝra a papa sǝr tagǝ nǝ tanggǝrma ta, aga ja sǝn ndǝr, ǝnga ja tsǝya patǝr njira nggǝl ara gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli.
Naja tsu kǝ ji ciwa kalar ndau, ndǝ kushu ǝnga ndǝ dǝgalǝu, ndǝr gǝnna ǝnga ndǝra gǝra gǝnna, kambau ǝnga mafa, aga nda dlǝwuri mǝtsamǝ kau ar pǝl mazǝma nda ma aˈyi mai ar huɗǝma nda.
Ji mǝl abangau ara ndǝ a sara ɗǝlbiya ǝnga ɗǝlna sau, kǝl ndǝra ǝnga mǝtsamǝ kau, ca ngǝ ndaliya thlǝmǝr sǝr tagǝ kau, ǝnga lamba nǝ thlǝmǝ nyi.
Sǝ kau wu yiwu hahangǝkur. Ma ndǝ aˈyi ǝnga sǝnbiya, bǝgǝ ja jigabiya lamba sǝr tagǝ kau, ara lamba nǝ ndapi ngau, lamba kau, ca ngǝ 666.
